2610.02885.title: PsyEvo: A Personalized Counseling Agent That Self-Evolves at Test Time
2610.02885.paper_summary: Mental health disorders affect a substantial proportion of the global population, yet a persistent shortage of trained practitioners leaves the majority without adequate care. Large language model (LLM)-based counselors present a promising direction for delivering scalable conversational psychological support. Offline model training alone leaves limited room to adapt to individual clients or to learn from ongoing therapeutic interaction at test time. We introduce PsyEvo, an LLM-based counseling framework that enables both client-specific personalization and response-policy improvement at test time through three components: Hierarchical Bayesian Skill Policy (HBSP) personalizes what intervention to apply by maintaining a per-client skill posterior updated from session feedback; Inter-session Listwise Preference Optimization (LiPO) improves how the selected skill is expressed by updating a shared response adapter from cross-client preference evidence; and State-conditioned Ordinal Credit Assignment (SOCA) supplies candidate preferences and trajectory credit to the two components through consistency-checked comparisons and ordinal projection. In simulated-client evaluation with shared online cohort adaptation, PsyEvo obtains 7.684 Overall on PsychEval and exceeds every component variant in each of three matched runs. Removing individual components lowers mean overall score by 0.138--0.171 under the shared configuration, supporting conditional contributions within the complete scaffold. Our code is available at https://github.com/Lingxi-mental-health/PsyEvo
2610.02885.paper_summary_zh: 心理健康障礙影響著全球相當大比例的人口，但持續缺乏受過訓練的從業人員使大多數人無法獲得足夠的護理。基於大型語言模型（LLM）的輔導員為提供可擴展的對話心理支持提供了一個有前景的方向。僅僅依賴離線模型訓練，對於適應個別客戶或從測試時的持續治療互動中學習的空間有限。我們介紹了PsyEvo，一個基於LLM的輔導框架，通過三個組件實現客戶特定的個性化和測試時的反應策略改進：層次貝葉斯技能政策（HBSP）通過保持從會話反饋中更新的每位客戶的技能後驗，個性化應用的干預；會話間列表偏好優化（LiPO）通過從跨客戶偏好證據更新共享反應適配器，改善所選技能的表達；狀態條件序數信用分配（SOCA）通過一致性檢查比較和序數投影向這兩個組件提供候選偏好和軌跡信用。在與共享在線隊列適應的模擬客戶評估中，PsyEvo在PsychEval上獲得了7.684的總體得分，並在三次匹配運行中的每個組件變體中超越了所有。移除個別組件使得在共享配置下的平均總體得分降低了0.138至0.171，支持了完整框架內的條件貢獻。我們的代碼可在https://github.com/Lingxi-mental-health/PsyEvo獲取。
